text_block_list.name: TV Celebrity
text_block_list.text: It's finally here! It's time for Derby<n>Week!

text_block_list.name: TV Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
On this week's show, we'll be<n>bringing you live
interviews with each<n>of the competitors! We'll be
kicking<n>things off with Ines Fujin! Can you<n>hear us?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This is Ines Fujin, and I'm here<n>with my
trainer!
choice_data_list: A pleasure to be on the show!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you certainly seem a little<n>nervous there,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
But that's not surprising when your<n>trainee is
competing in the Derby! Not<n>to mention, her track
record indicates<n>she has the talent to claim victory!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
In all honesty, have you ever felt<n>overwhelmed by
the responsibility on<n>your shoulders?
choice_data_list: Not at all. I have complete confidence!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haha. My trainer promised to lead me<n>to victory as
the number one favorite!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty self-indulgent, to be fair.<n>I've only been
able to make it this far<n>because I have my trainer
and my<n>family behind me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (That's why I believe in them!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(My family isn't particularly wealthy.<n>To be honest,
I felt like I'd just be a<n>burden on them if I enrolled
in the<n>academy.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(But Mom and Dad told me not worry,<n>and my little
sisters cheered me on.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Even after all that, I still can't bring<n>myself to fully
depend on their<n>kindness.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I know I should concentrate more on<n>my training,
but I want to keep<n>working part-time to support my
sisters as they pursue their dreams.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Yet in spite of all that hassle, my<n>trainer still chose
to accept me.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My trainer is truly amazing. So just<n>sit back and
watch us achieve<n>greatness.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
When the two of us put our heads<n>together, we're
unstoppable. Even if<n>we get marked as the
favorites, I<n>know we'll still pull through.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My dream right now is to win the<n>Derby as the
number one favorite!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I wonder if I came on a little<n>too strong
during the interview.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to lose after saying all<n>that. Heh-heh,
are you ready for this,<n>Trainer?
choice_data_list: I've always believed that you'll win.
I've always believed that you'll win.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. I know you have faith in me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm going to pour<n>everything I have
into the race ahead<n>of us!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whatever it takes to win!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Go Ines! You can do it,<n>Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible atmosphere! We<n>just received
confirmation that<n>we've got an all-time record
number<n>of spectators here for today's Derby!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So, Ines. This is our first race together<n>since the
Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yes, and that was only a month ago.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But I can see you've grown even<n>more
dependable, Ryan. Each time<n>we meet, it's like
you're a whole<n>different person.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You think so? ...Haha, well, it's an<n>honor to hear
you say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You probably don't realize it, but<n>you're the one
who brought me this<n>far.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
When I watched you, it helped me<n>bring my own
dream into focus.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Your dream?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can't let you win the<n>Derby! No matter
how hard you try to<n>break away, I'll overtake you
in the<n>end!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Listen, Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Big Sis! Do your beeest!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's not gonna happen. I won't let<n>you snatch
victory out of my grasp.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Well then, we'll just have to settle<n>this on the track.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, game on! After all...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: This isn't just my dream that I'm<n>fighting for.
